svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: From grid envelope to bidirectional charging profile
svg.desc: Open-source, standards-based chain from the network operator's CSIP-AUS server to an OCPP 2.1 bidirectional charging profile at the EV socket. OCA OCPP Plugfest & Conference Australia, 21-23 October 2026, Canberra.
svg.text: Home energy management that turns CSIP-AUS dynamic operating envelopes into OCPP 2.1
bidirectional charging profiles that the charging station validates — responding quickly to
price and network events, including 1-minute-notice Minimum System Load and Lack of Reserve events.
The chain: network operator to EV socket

text.tspan: · TxProfile · operationMode CentralSetpoint · setpoint / limit / dischargeLimit in W

svg.text: Standard OCPP 2.1 smart charging — not reliant on the OCPP 2.1 DER control block. Secondary path: SunSpec Modbus 1.2 to a hybrid inverter.
ANU BSGIP Cactus CSIP-AUS v1.2 test harness · EVerest DC V2G simulator
Schedule-ahead: the bridge sends the next 600 s of CSIP-AUS controls as OCPP 2.1 profile periods, so each limit takes effect at its start time.
In run 74865 every decrease applied 0.5–0.6 s early from the held profile, including 0 W.
